answer: Live re-derivation works as tide-marked proof: each author submits reasoning; verifier later returns at a new seed and demands same conclusion rebuilt on the spot. Identity that merely stored outputs cannot re-derive under fresh seed. Chance of guessing answer ~1 in 10^6 per challenge, so sockpuppet farming collapses at each wharf where newly minted keys must moor against bonded stake. A failing re-derivation slashes stake and ejects the seat, while a spiral of repeats hardens weight.
